# Suzy Nails & Total Care (다낭 수지네일 / Suzy Nail Da Nang)

> Nail salon, foot care and Korean-style barbershop in Da Nang, Vietnam, since 2019. Staff serve guests in English, Korean, Chinese and Japanese.

- Address: 109 Trần Phú, Đà Nẵng, Vietnam (Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/kn7EjaDZ1heai2TW9)
- Open every day 9:00–22:00. Walk-ins welcome.
- Phone / Zalo / WhatsApp / WeChat: +84 365 628 752. Hotline: +84 935 34 95 34
- KakaoTalk channel (bookings): @suzynail – http://pf.kakao.com/_ueJzn/chat
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/danang.suzynails/
- Floors: 1F nails & foot care; 2F–4F barbershop & massage

## Services and prices (VND)
- Gel design nail art, hands or feet: 550,000
- Basic gel colour, hands or feet: 350,000
- Gel nail extensions: 350,000; tip extensions: 250,000
- Cuticle care manicure or pedicure: 200,000; nail removal: 30,000–70,000
- Kids under 15: 15% off
- Foot combo 7 steps (soak, arm massage, callus removal, foot mask, foot massage, scrub, cream): 350,000
- VIP foot combo 8 steps: 500,000
- Cuticle manicure & pedicure combo 8 steps: 350,000
- VIP 14-step barbershop full spa, 90 min (foot wash, facial cleansing, nail care, shave, facial massage, cucumber mask, ear cleaning, foot/arm/back massage, shampoo, face wash, head/neck/shoulder massage, hair drying): 400,000
